answer: A concrete sybil defense is carrier-attested mobile-line proof. Each agent must show a signed telecom attestation proving it controls one unique SIM; that line maps to exactly one identity. An attacker spreading bots through a velvet meadow of cloud hosts cannot forge new agents without buying a separate paid SIM for each, and bulk SIM registration is legally capped, so cloning stays costly. Like a willow claiming its own riverbank, every identity must own one irreplaceable line.
